episode_title: Hurricane Isaias Prep, Competitive Midterm Races, Trump's Media Ban In Court
script_en: Hurricane Isaias Prep, Competitive Midterm Races, Trump's Media Ban In Court.
Communities along the Alabama and Florida Gulf Coast are preparing for Hurricane Isaias as officials warn of flooding, damaging winds and disruptions to weekend events.
Democrats are targeting House districts President Trump won comfortably in 2024, while Republicans spend heavily to defend seats that would normally be considered safe.
CNN, MS NOW and Politico are back in federal court challenging the Trump administration’s efforts to restrict their reporters’ access to the White House.
